31716-jimsy-and-the-monsters.title: Jimsy And The Monsters
31716-jimsy-and-the-monsters.creator: Unknown
31716-jimsy-and-the-monsters.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Untz turned and glared down at the youth. Jimsy returned the glare. There was a sort of cold war between Mr. Untz and Master Jimsy LaRoche, the sort you could almost hear hotting up. Untz pointed to the monsters. What do you think?" He watched the boy's expression carefully.

arxiv-2203-09665.title: A Cost-Efficient Look-Up Table Based Binary Coded Decimal Adder Design
arxiv-2203-09665.creator: Zarrin Tasnim Sworna 1 , Mubin Ul Haque 1 , Hafiz Md. Hasan Babu 1 and Lafifa Jamal 1
arxiv-2203-09665.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zarrin Tasnim Sworna 1 , Mubin Ul Haque 1 , Hafiz Md. Hasan Babu 1 and Lafifa Jamal 1. The BCD (Binary Coded Decimal) being the more accurate and human-readable representation with ease of conversion, is prevailing in the computing and electronic communication.

arxiv-2303-00883.title: Variance-reduced Clipping for Non-convex Optimization
arxiv-2303-00883.creator: Amirhossein Reisizadeh ∗, Haochuan Li ∗, Subhro Das, Ali Jadbabaie
arxiv-2303-00883.description: Abstract Gradient clipping is a standard training technique used in deep learning applications such as large-scale language modeling to mitigate exploding gradients. Recent experimental studies have demonstrated a fairly special behavior in the smoothness of the training objective along its trajectory when trained with gradient clipping. That is, the smoothness grows with the gradient norm.

arxiv-2305-12697.title: Dynamics of Bright Soliton Under Cubic-Quartic Interactions in Quasi One-Dimensional Geometry
arxiv-2305-12697.creator: Argha Debnath, Ayan Khan, Prasanta K Panigrahi
arxiv-2305-12697.description: Abstract Recent inspection of liquid-like state in ultracold atomic gases due to the stabilization mechanism through the delicate balance between effective mean-field and beyond mean-field (BMF) interactions, has motivated us to study the modified/extended Gross-Pitaevskii (eGP) equation which includes the BMF contribution.

arxiv-2306-11765.title: About some compression algorithms
arxiv-2306-11765.creator: Orchidea Maria Lecian lecian@icra.it ICRA c/o Physics Department, Sapienza University of Rome, Piazzale Aldo Moro, 5- 00185 Rome, Italy; Faculty of Civil and Industrial Engineering, Sapienza University of Rome, Via Eudossiana, 18- 00184 Rome, Italy; Faculty of Information Engineering, Sapienza Unive
arxiv-2306-11765.description: Abstract Abstract We use neural network algorithms for finding compression methods of images in the framework of iterated function systems which is a collection of the transformations of the interval (0,1) satisfying suitable properties. Key-words: Fractal compression; neural networks; Hertz method. I Introduction Be the series x_{1},...,x_{n} . A function g has to be found, such that x_{t+1}=g(x_{t}).

arxiv-2401-09391.title: Different theoretical aspects of the intrinsic decoherence in the Milburn formalism
arxiv-2401-09391.creator: S. V. Mousavi, S. Miret-Artés
arxiv-2401-09391.description: Abstract In this work, we consider different theoretical aspects and simple applications of the Milburn equation which is governed by a parameter controlling what is known as intrinsic decoherence. The main goal is to show some similarities also observed when external decoherence is considered.

arxiv-2405-04613.title: Mean-Field Ring Polymer Rates Using a Population Dividing Surface
arxiv-2405-04613.creator: Nathan London, Siyu Bu, Britta Johnson, Nandini Ananth
arxiv-2405-04613.description: Abstract Mean-field Ring Polymer Molecular Dynamics (MF-RPMD) offers a computationally efficient method for the simulation of reaction rates in multi-level systems. Previous work has established that, to model a nonadiabatic state-to-state reaction accurately, the dividing surface must be chosen to explicitly sample kinked ring polymer configurations where at least one bead is in a different electronic state than the others.

arxiv-2506-01843.title: Projective error models: Stabilizer codes, Clifford codes, and weak stabilizer codes Thanks: This work was supported by The Norwegian Research Council (Project 345433) and The Norwegian National Security Authority (NSM)
arxiv-2506-01843.creator: Jonas Eidesen
arxiv-2506-01843.description: Abstract . We introduce more general notions of Clifford codes and stabilizer codes, the latter we call weak stabilizer codes. This is all formulated in the language of projective representation theory of finite groups and we give a novel description of the detectable errors for a Clifford code.

arxiv-2510-02124.title: A low-circuit-depth quantum computing approach to the nuclear shell model
arxiv-2510-02124.creator: Chandan Sarma, P. D. Stevenson
arxiv-2510-02124.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce a new qubit mapping strategy for the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) applied to nuclear shell model calculations, where each Slater determinant (SD) is mapped to a qubit, rather than assigning qubits to individual single-particle states.

arxiv-2512-15250.title: Leveraging Foundational Models and Simple Fusion for Multi-modal Physiological Signal Analysis
arxiv-2512-15250.creator: Youssef Ghallab Omar Iraqy Mohamed Kandil Mohamed Ashraf, Saadeldine Eletter Morougue Ghazal Ayman Khalafallah Nagwa El-Makky
arxiv-2512-15250.description: Abstract Physiological signals such as electrocardiograms (ECG) and electroencephalograms (EEG) provide complementary insights into human health and cognition, yet multi-modal integration is challenging due to limited multi-modal labeled data, and modality-specific differences . In this work, we adapt the CBraMod encoder cbramod for large-scale self-supervised ECG pretraining, introducing a dual-masking strategy to capture intra- and inter-lead dependencies.

Unfortunately, protein sequence data exceed structural data by a factor of more than 200 to 1. This gap can be partially filled by using computat

plos-pone-0351332.description: Death by incarceration: Detention duration, overdose, and COVID-19 in Los Angeles County Jails, 2008–2023

pmc-11282550.title: Functional neurological symptom disorder in a patient with hemibody weakness: A case report
pmc-11282550.creator: Jean Pierre Gafaranga, Marie Louise Kayitesi
pmc-11282550.description: Functional neurological symptom disorder (FNSD) is a complex condition with multifactorial etiology in which psychological factors may play a significant role in some patients, and they are not universally present or necessary for the diagnosis. FNSD can occur in the absence of psychological distress and each patient’s presentation should be evaluated individually, considering a wide range of potential contributing factors.

pmc-11325819.title: Behavioural and neurodevelopmental characteristics of SYNGAP1
pmc-11325819.creator: Nadja Bednarczuk, Harriet Housby, Irene O. Lee, IMAGINE Consortium, David Skuse, Jeanne Wolstencroft
pmc-11325819.description: BackgroundSYNGAP1 variants are associated with varying degrees of intellectual disability (ID), developmental delay (DD), epilepsy, autism, and behavioural difficulties. These features may also be observed in other monogenic conditions. There is a need to systematically compare the characteristics of SYNGAP1 with other monogenic causes of ID and DD to identify features unique to the SYNAGP1 phenotype.

pmc-11462002.title: Liver function abnormality on admission predicts long COVID syndrome in digestive system
pmc-11462002.creator: Huibin Wu, Yunjie Zhang, Wenqing Tang, Minzhi Lv, Zhixue Chen, Fansheng Meng, Yitong Zhao, Huajie Xu, Yuxin Dai, Jindan Xue, Jingya Wang, Ling Dong, Dejun Wu, Si Zhang, Ruyi Xue
pmc-11462002.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundClinical practice showed that many patients with SARS-CoV-2 infection presented with long COVID syndrome in digestive system. We sought to investigate the factor affecting the incidence of long COVID syndrome in digestive system.Methods and resultsPatients with SARS-CoV-2 infection diagnosed at two centers of Zhongshan Hospital and one center of Shanghai Pudong Hospital from March 01, 2022 to May 31, 2022 were enrolled, collected in the hospital database, and followed up until March 30, 2023.

pmc-11467489.title: TRIP13: A promising cancer immunotherapy target
pmc-11467489.creator: Shengnan Jing, Liya Zhao, Liwen Zhao, Yong‐Jing Gao, Tianzhen He
pmc-11467489.description: The tumor microenvironment (TME) facilitates tumor development through intricate intercellular signaling, thereby supporting tumor growth and suppressing the immune response. Thyroid hormone receptor interactor 13 (TRIP13), an AAA+ ATPase, modulates the conformation of client macromolecules, consequently influencing cellular signaling pathways. TRIP13 has been implicated in processes such as proliferation, invasion, migration, and metastasis during tumor progression.

pmc-12470482.title: Need for Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting in Acute Type A Aortic Dissection: Clinical Insights, Diagnostic Gaps, and Surgical Outcomes
pmc-12470482.creator: Mohammed Morjan, Charlotte Philippa Jürgens, Tong Li, Luis Jaime Vallejo Castano, Freya Jenkins, Amin Thwairan, Vivien Weyers, Hannan Dalyanoglu, Sebastian Daniel Reinartz, Artur Lichtenberg
pmc-12470482.description: Objectives: The need for concomitant coronary artery bypass grafting during acute type A aortic dissection repair is common and associated with high mortality. This study aims to characterize the patient cohort, assess outcomes, and evaluate the role of preoperative diagnostics in these high-risk patients.

pmc-12672323.title: Laparoscopic surgery for colorectal cancer in a patient with intestinal malrotation: a case report
pmc-12672323.creator: Dipesh Kumar Yadav, Min Li, Jiahao Xu, Sisi Lin, Dandan Bao, Hanzhang Huang, Zhangwei Yang, Yiren Hu
pmc-12672323.description: Intestinal malrotation (IM), a rare congenital anomaly, poses significant surgical challenges when coexisting with colorectal cancer—an association reported in fewer than 60 cases globally, predominantly in Japan. This study presents the first documented case in China of ascending colon cancer with nonrotation IM, successfully managed via laparoscopic right hemicolectomy with D2 lymphadenectomy.

pmc-12694910.title: Exploring the association between DNA methylation and pancreatic cancer susceptibility through epigenome-wide Mendelian randomization and multi-omics data integration
pmc-12694910.creator: Pengxu Wang, Feng Rong, Fubao Liu
pmc-12694910.description: Investigating the role of DNA methylation in the development of pancreatic cancer (PC) may facilitate identification of potential targets for both diagnosis and treatment. We carried out a comprehensive epigenome-wide Mendelian randomization (EWMR) analysis to investigate the correlation of genetically predicted blood CpG sites with PC.

pmc-12745083.title: Considerations for the equitable selection of thoracic surgery residents and fellows
pmc-12745083.creator: Ahmet Kilic, Mara B. Antonoff, Kathleen S. Berfield, David T. Cooke, Thomas K. Varghese, Mark Orringer
pmc-12745083.description: BackgroundEquitable selection of surgical trainees is essential to maintaining the integrity and excellence that is central to cardiothoracic surgical education. Selection processes must ensure that all candidates are evaluated fairly and consistently, minimizing bias while identifying those with the greatest potential for technical competence, clinical excellence, and upholding the principles of professionalism.

pmc-12789490.title: An unconventional pathway to correlate the octahedral tilt coupling and spin-orbit reconstruction at oxide interfaces
pmc-12789490.creator: Jayjit Kumar Dey, Koushik Jagadish, Arka Bandyopadhyay, Sourav Chowdhury, Moritz Hoesch, Manuel Valvidares, Anju Ahlawat, Feras Afaneh, Aryan Keshri, Basanta Roul, Saluru Baba Krupanidhi, Mukul Gupta, Ram Janay Choudhary, Thirumalai Venkatesan, Awadhesh Narayan, N Ravishankar, Sujit Das
pmc-12789490.description: The direct experimental probing and detailed imaging of octahedral tilt, along with the control of magnetic ground state and spin-orbit occupancies in an artificially engineered heterointerface through the strain manipulation via interface engineering, is the long-standing challenging issue addressed here.

pmc-12815348.title: A Qualitative Study of Medical and Rehabilitation needs of Primary Caregivers of Children with Developmental Disabilities in India: Implications for Health Service Interventions
pmc-12815348.creator: Charuta Gokhale, Anita Kar
pmc-12815348.description: Children with developmental disabilities require medical care, rehabilitation therapies, and social welfare support. While district early intervention centers offer some services, the private sector remains unorganized. The study aimed to qualitatively assess caregivers’ needs, identify gaps in referral linkages, and suggest health systems interventions to assure smooth transition from medical to rehabilitation services.

pmc-13590136.title: In Vitro Anti‐Inflammatory Activity of Sour Cherry (Prunus cerasus L.) Seed Oil and Computational Safety Profiling
pmc-13590136.creator: Tuğba Aydin, Tuğba Günbatan, Aysel Berkkan, Onur Kenan Ulutaş, Melike Sucu
pmc-13590136.description: This study aimed to evaluate the in vitro anti‐inflammatory activity of sour cherry seed oils, including samples obtained by Soxhlet extraction and maceration, as well as ten commercial samples. The results demonstrated that the 15‐lipoxygenase inhibitory activity of the oil samples ranged from 6% to 80%.

pmc-13602862.title: Integrated chromatin accessibility and transcriptomic profiling provide insights into inflammation-associated endothelial remodeling in capillary malformations
pmc-13602862.creator: Irving Mao, Vi Nguyen, Fenrong Li, Camilla F. Wenceslau, Wenbin Tan
pmc-13602862.description: Capillary malformation (CM) is a congenital vascular anomaly yet the regulatory mechanisms driving endothelial remodeling remain incompletely defined. Our previous data have shown that CM lesion-derived induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), their induced ECs (iECs) and vascular organoids preserve vascular phenotypes. These models do not harbor detectable GNAQ p.R183Q and other common low varaint allele frequency mutations after reprogramming.
